capabilities: play sounds from clickable folder tiles with per-track loop, volume and stop controls
run playlist subfolders with sequential playback, shuffle, fades and next/previous controls
trigger sounds and playlists from Markdown buttons in notes
mix multiple overlapping sounds with exclusive-playback fade-outs and a Stop All button
stream large audio files via HTMLAudioElement to start long ambience tracks faster

summary: Soundboard that plays sound effects, music and ambience from vault folders, with playlists, overlap control, per-track settings and note buttons.
